power_profile.source: Same low-power tag family as CompassTag; VIN is VBAT less one Schottky drop, no regulator.
notes: BitTagNG is a super-low-power device; typical current is about 10 uA.
J401 is an MS621 3 V rechargeable coin cell. VIN is roughly 2.8 V.
Binding supply limit is 3.6 V (STM32L432KC and ADXL367). Absolute max is 4.0 V for both.
Do not substitute a 3.7 V LiPo: at 4.2 V charged, VIN reaches about 4.0 V, at the absolute maximum.
Narrow 0.1016 mm traces are a fabrication/process-selection concern, not a current-capacity concern for this load profile.

mating_design.name: BitTagNG tag on external baseboard
mating_design.source: Designer response during the 2026-08-31 design review.
notes: This tag is driven by an external baseboard through J201.
Q501's base series resistor is on the baseboard, NOT on this board. Net RST reaching Q501.1 with no series resistor is intentional. Any new baseboard must supply it.

SCL/SDA have no external pull-ups by design. Firmware uses a slow bit-banged software I2C driver on the STM32 internal pull-ups (RPU 25/40/55 kOhm). Measured worst-case rise time is 730 ns against the 1000 ns standard-mode limit.
Do not move to the hardware I2C peripheral or 400 kHz without adding external pull-ups first.
AT25_nCS and ACCEL_CS have no external pull-ups; firmware must drive both high as the first GPIO action after reset.
Both SPI devices share SPI1 on two pin mappings (ADXL367 on PA5/PA6/PA7, AT25 on PB3/PA11/PA12). PA6 and PA11 must never be muxed to SPI1_MISO simultaneously.
U302 PA3 (pin 9) is hard-tied to GND. Never configure PA3 as an output.
WKUP4 ties U2 INT1 to both PA0 and PA2; neither may be configured as an output.
RV-3028 CLKOUT drives PC14/OSC32_IN. The MCU must run LSE in bypass mode, not crystal-drive mode.

suppressions.reason: Low-power design: about 10 uA typical, below 1 mA operating, about 10 mA peak during flash write. Treat 0.1016 mm traces as advanced-process DFM notes, not current-capacity concerns.
VBAT is the external battery input rail sourced at J401; KiCad ERC is clean. Analyzer wants a PWR_FLAG.
Flash deselect is a firmware/reset-state contract using STM32 internal pull-up configuration, matching the CompassTag convention. No external pull-up by design.
ADXL367 INT2 is a push-pull output (datasheet Rev B Table 9 p.13), not an open-drain line needing a pull-up. An unused output may float.
17.25 x 9.0 mm tag; J201 provides VIN, GND, SWDIO, SWCLK, RST and VBAT for bring-up. ICT-style test-point coverage is not the production-test target.
J301-J304 are 1.1 mm mounting holes modelled as one-pin connectors, not cable I/O. EMC filtering suggestions do not apply.
J201 is a compact SWD/debug header; the ground-pin ratio warning is informational for this prototype.
Clock-near-connector findings cite the J301-J304 mounting holes. SWCLK is active only during debug and clkout is 32.768 kHz.
Intentional two-layer compact low-power tag. Treat as a return-path/EMC caution, not a stackup blocker.
Fiducials belong on the assembly panel rails, not on a 17 x 9 mm tag. See panel-copy.kicad_pro. Confirm the panel carries them.

known_false_positives: PS-002 / RP-002 GND island splits: the analyzer union-find does not merge copper the way KiCad does. KiCad DRC reports 0 unconnected items. Verify with kicad-cli before believing any island finding.
TV-001 'vias not tented': the PCB sets (viasonmask false), which means vias ARE tented.
via_in_pad at U302 with same_net false: all three vias inside the exposed pad are on GND. Confirmed by computing via positions against the pad-33 rectangle.
TB-001 tombstoning rationale cites a ground pour; this board has no zones at all.
open_items: No copper zones anywhere. GND/VIN are trace-routed only. Adding GND pours on both layers with stitching vias is the highest-value layout improvement available.
U302 Value says stm32l431kc but MPN is STM32L432KCU6; U1 Value says at25ex321D-UUN but MPN is AT25FF321A-UUN-T. Correct at the next schematic edit.
C6 sits about 0.27 mm from the routed board edge; confirm the depanel method.
VBAT is exposed on J201.2 with no charge control and the MS621 is rechargeable; document charge voltage and current.
0.102 mm annular ring is below IPC Class 2; confirm the fab quotes an advanced class.
